summary: Focused regression on 'Safety Check-In' (dead-man's switch) + 'Fake-Off Decoy' features on the in-workspace NekSathi stack. Backend: full pytest suite (21/21) passes against EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL, including POST /api/me/sos and GET /api/me/sos-events used by the auto-SOS path. Frontend E2E on Expo web (390x844): (1) /check-in start card renders with 15/30/60 chips; tapping checkin-15 flips to checkin-active showing a live 14:57 countdown and 'I'm safe' button. Storage key 'neksathi_checkin' persisted with active=true and future ISO deadline. (2) Auto-SOS reconcile verified end-to-end: overwrote localStorage[neksathi_checkin] with a past deadline, then focused Home tab -> reconcileCheckIn fired, /api/me/sos returned a new event, home stat-sos incremented 7 -> 8, the SOS-active red banner appeared, and the stored check-in was cleared to {active:false,deadline:''}. The 'Check-in missed - SOS sent automatically' toast rendered but auto-dismissed before the DOM snapshot (functional path is correct, only timing). (3) /decoy renders phase 1 (ActivityIndicator + 'Shutting down...') then transitions to the black-screen phase 2 with the low-contrast 'Long-press anywhere for 1.5s to exit' hint after ~1.6s; startGuardian() is invoked and returns cleanly on web (guardian requires native build, no crash). (4) UI entry points are wired: Safety tab -> safety-checkin -> /check-in, Security tab -> decoy-button -> /decoy. No React Native red screens, no page errors, no new deprecation issues beyond the pre-existing RN-Web shadow*/pointerEvents warnings from third-party components (already tracked in iteration_2).
action_items: No functional fixes required for check-in or decoy. Both flows verified end-to-end on web preview.
(Nice-to-have) Consider using router.canGoBack() before router.back() in /decoy so a cold-open (no history) can fall back to a safe route instead of logging 'GO_BACK not handled'.

(Nice-to-have) Increase toast duration for the auto-SOS reconcile toast, or replace with a persistent banner, since the countdown user is unlikely to be looking at the screen the exact second they focus Home.
critical_code_review_comments: src/services/checkin.ts stores JSON.stringify(payload) into storage.setItem which itself JSON.stringifies again; getCheckIn() JSON.parses once more. Works end-to-end (verified via localStorage inspection) but is double-encoded; could be simplified by moving to storage.setItem with a raw string and dropping the outer JSON.stringify. Minor tech-debt only.
reconcileCheckIn() correctly clears the check-in BEFORE calling triggerSos so a network error can never re-fire an SOS on the next focus.
server.py POST /api/me/sos and GET /api/me/sos-events cleanly return without Mongo _id (uses clean()); auto-SOS event is included in list and increases stats.sos count as expected.
app/(tabs)/index.tsx wires reconcileCheckIn into useFocusEffect and shows the correct toast on fired=true - confirmed via localStorage-injected past deadline.
app/decoy.tsx correctly uses Pressable delayLongPress={1500}; catches startGuardian() rejection; two-phase timer cleaned up on unmount.
seed_data_creation: Reused existing seeded demo data. E2E test created one additional SOS event (stat.sos on home 7 -> 8) via the auto-reconcile path; check-in storage entry was cleared afterward.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-SOS reconcile is verified by manipulating localStorage['neksathi_checkin'] (AsyncStorage web falls back to localStorage). The stored value is double-JSON-stringified (outer layer from storage.setItem's JSON.stringify + inner from checkin.ts). To simulate a missed check-in: localStorage.setItem('neksathi_checkin', JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify({active:true, deadline: <past ISO>}))) then navigate to '/' - useFocusEffect on Home fires reconcileCheckIn. Backend endpoints exercised by check-in: POST /api/me/sos, GET /api/me/sos-events (already covered in test_neksathi_api.py). Decoy on web preview cannot exercise real Guardian tracking - startGuardian() is expected to return {ok:false, error:'Background Guardian works on the installed app, not the web preview.'} without throwing.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no functional bugs found for the requested features.
